summary: The census label Next Wave Energy is an alias of the existing Next Wave Energy Partners, LP platform, so no company or duplicate owner should be added. Direct sources prove an initial ECP investment in April 2015, ECP's manager-reported March 2018 investment date and later explicit Fund IV ownership. The canonical boundary includes Project Traveler and Pasadena Performance Products as project/facility entities, while project debt and later refinancing do not change corporate ownership. ECP still marks the platform Current and no exit or signed owner transfer was found.
